name: Exhibition Production
description: Develop an exhibition from curatorial premise through artwork logistics, interpretation, installation, accessibility, opening, and deinstallation.

tasks.name: Define curatorial premise
tasks.objective: State the exhibition question, audience, scope, selection logic, venue conditions, budget, interpretive approach, accessibility goals, and constraints.

tasks.name: Build works and rights register
tasks.objective: Confirm artists/works, dimensions, media, owners/lenders, availability, rights, image permissions, valuations, condition, transport, insurance, display requirements, and contacts.

tasks.name: Develop spatial and interpretive design
tasks.objective: Plan layout, sightlines, sequence, mounts, lighting, sound bleed, power/network, labels, wayfinding, seating, accessibility, media playback, and visitor flow.

tasks.name: Coordinate fabrication and logistics
tasks.objective: Schedule packing, shipping, couriers, customs if relevant, fabrication, mounts, printing, AV, installers, condition reporting, storage, security, and vendor responsibilities.

tasks.name: Install and verify
tasks.objective: Execute installation with condition checks, measurements, label proofing, AV testing, lighting, accessibility routes, safety, rights/credit checks, and artist/curator approvals.

tasks.name: Open, operate, and deinstall
tasks.objective: Document opening readiness, maintenance/media checks, incidents, attendance/feedback, deinstallation sequence, condition reports, returns, archive, and lessons.
